title: Choose the nearest emergency station
summary: An emergency dispatch tool compares the caller’s coordinates with a list of defibrillator locations. Select the nearest station using the distance calculation defined by the exercise. Find the closest station to latitude/longitude coordinates by approximate geographic distance.
requirements: Coordinates are decimal degrees; use x=ΔlongitudeRadians*cos(meanLatitudeRadians), y=ΔlatitudeRadians, d=6371*sqrt(x²+y²).
Return the first station name in ties, or null for no stations.
hints: Compute squared planar angular distance for each station and keep the nearest.
